product.name: Gomrey
product.version_policy: P02-G4 resets the inherited 0.9.11-beta donor-family version to a Gomrey-owned 0.1.0 baseline. The desktop app uses a separate appId, so this is a fresh application identity rather than a semver downgrade. P16 owns GA versioning.

desktop.update_policy: opt-in only; no donor update endpoint by default

release.publish_policy: No release to end users in P02. P16 owns GA release and operations. Test prereleases must target TheHalfMoon/Gomrey only and never require Store credentials in ordinary CI.

source_binding.commit: recorded at manifest generation time via git rev-parse HEAD
